about.text: A mixed sheep-and-cow caciotta made across the whole of Lazio, a traditional product (PAT), raw or semi-cooked and sometimes flavoured with chilli. The milk is set with calf or lamb rennet, the curd is broken and moulded, then it is salted and dried. It is ripened from one day up to 30 days.
